```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

## Data Inputs

```{r paths}
repo_root <- normalizePath("..")
box_2024 <- file.path(repo_root, "2024", "master_boxscore.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(box_2024))
```

## Inspect Boxscore Structure

```{r inspect}
df_head <- suppressMessages(read_csv(box_2024, n_max = 5, show_col_types = FALSE))
print(names(df_head))
print(str(df_head))
```

## Load Boxscores (Team Totals, Basic) and Build Priors

```{r load_priors}
load_box_totals <- function(path, season) {
  raw <- suppressMessages(read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE))
  df <- raw %>%
    filter(player == "School Totals", str_to_lower(table_type) == "basic") %>%
    transmute(
      season = season,
      game_id,
      game_date = as.Date(game_date),
      sid = str_trim(team),
      opp_sid = if_else(is.na(opponent) | opponent == "", "no_sid", str_trim(opponent)),
      across(
        .cols = setdiff(names(.), c("game_id","game_date","team","opponent","table_type","player")),
        .fns = ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)),
        .names = "tm_{.col}"
      )
    )
  df
}

box_totals <- load_box_totals(box_2024, "2024") %>%
  filter(opp_sid != "no_sid")

opp_stats <- box_totals %>%
  select(game_id, sid, starts_with("tm_")) %>%
  rename(opp_sid = sid) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^tm_", "opp_"), starts_with("tm_"))

box_full <- box_totals %>%
  left_join(opp_stats, by = c("game_id", "opp_sid")) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, "%", "pct")) %>%
  mutate(win = as.integer(.data[["tm_PTS"]] > .data[["opp_PTS"]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(win))

# Prior function (expanding mean of previous games only)
prior_mean <- function(x) {
  s <- cumsum(replace(x, is.na(x), 0))
  n <- cumsum(!is.na(x))
  lag(s) / lag(n)
}

tm_cols  <- names(box_full)[startsWith(names(box_full), "tm_")]
opp_cols <- names(box_full)[startsWith(names(box_full), "opp_")]

box_prior <- box_full %>%
  arrange(game_date) %>%
  group_by(sid) %>%
  mutate(
    gp_prior = lag(cumsum(rep(1L, dplyr::n()))),
    across(all_of(tm_cols),  prior_mean, .names = "pr_{.col}"),
    across(all_of(opp_cols), prior_mean, .names = "pr_{.col}")
  ) %>% ungroup()

opp_prior <- box_prior %>%
  select(sid, game_date, gp_prior, starts_with("pr_")) %>%
  rename(opp_gp_prior = gp_prior) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("opp_", .x), starts_with("pr_"))

model_df <- box_prior %>%
  left_join(opp_prior, by = c("opp_sid" = "sid", "game_date" = "game_date")) %>%
  filter(gp_prior >= 1, opp_gp_prior >= 1)

cat("Model rows available for rolling eval:", nrow(model_df), "\n")
```

## Rolling Daily Training/Evaluation (2025-01-01 to 2025-02-28)

```{r rolling_eval}
auc_manual <- function(labels, scores) {
  labels <- as.integer(labels)
  n_pos <- sum(labels == 1L)
  n_neg <- sum(labels == 0L)
  if (n_pos == 0 || n_neg == 0) return(NA_real_)
  r <- rank(scores, ties.method = "average")
  sum_pos_ranks <- sum(r[labels == 1L])
  auc <- (sum_pos_ranks - n_pos * (n_pos + 1) / 2) / (n_pos * n_neg)
  as.numeric(auc)
}

eval_dates <- seq(as.Date("2025-01-01"), as.Date("2025-02-28"), by = "day")

all_preds <- list()
daily_metrics <- list()

for (d in eval_dates) {
  train_df_day <- model_df %>% filter(game_date < d)
  test_df_day  <- model_df %>% filter(game_date == d)
  if (nrow(test_df_day) == 0 || nrow(train_df_day) == 0) next

  # Features: prior-derived only
  drop_cols <- c("season","game_id","game_date","sid","opp_sid","win","gp_prior","opp_gp_prior")
  num_cols_train <- names(train_df_day)[vapply(train_df_day, is.numeric, logical(1))]
  feature_cols <- setdiff(num_cols_train, drop_cols)
  feature_cols <- feature_cols[grepl("^pr_|^opp_pr_", feature_cols)]
  if (length(feature_cols) == 0) next

  train_features <- as.data.frame(train_df_day[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE])
  test_features  <- as.data.frame(test_df_day[,  intersect(names(test_df_day), feature_cols), drop = FALSE])

  # Sanitize and align names
  colmap <- stats::setNames(make.names(names(train_features)), names(train_features))
  names(train_features) <- unname(colmap[names(train_features)])
  names(test_features)  <- unname(colmap[names(test_features)])
  missing_in_test <- setdiff(names(train_features), names(test_features))
  if (length(missing_in_test) > 0) for (mc in missing_in_test) test_features[[mc]] <- NA_real_
  test_features <- test_features[, names(train_features), drop = FALSE]

  # Mean imputation from training
  train_means <- vapply(train_features, function(x) mean(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
  train_means[is.na(train_means)] <- 0
  for (nm in names(train_features)) {
    v <- as.numeric(train_features[[nm]]); v[is.na(v)] <- train_means[[nm]]; train_features[[nm]] <- v
  }
  for (nm in names(test_features)) {
    v <- as.numeric(test_features[[nm]]); v[is.na(v)] <- train_means[[nm]]; test_features[[nm]] <- v
  }

  y_train <- train_df_day$win
  y_test  <- test_df_day$win

  # Require both classes in training
  if (length(unique(y_train)) < 2) next

  # Fit logistic regression
  train_df_glm <- data.frame(win = y_train, train_features, check.names = TRUE)
  fit <- try(glm(win ~ ., data = train_df_glm, family = binomial(), control = list(maxit = 200)), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) next

  # Predict
  test_df_glm <- data.frame(test_features, check.names = TRUE)
  pred <- try(predict(fit, newdata = test_df_glm, type = "response"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(pred, "try-error")) next

  # Collect
  day_auc <- auc_manual(y_test, pred)
  daily_metrics[[as.character(d)]] <- tibble(date = d, n_games = length(y_test), auc = day_auc)
  all_preds[[as.character(d)]] <- test_df_day %>%
    transmute(
      date = game_date,
      game_id, sid, opp_sid,
      win = y_test,
      pred = as.numeric(pred)
    )
}

preds_df <- bind_rows(all_preds)
metrics_df <- bind_rows(daily_metrics)
overall_auc <- if (nrow(preds_df) > 0) auc_manual(preds_df$win, preds_df$pred) else NA_real_
list(
  total_games_scored = nrow(preds_df),
  overall_auc = overall_auc,
  daily_sample = head(metrics_df %>% arrange(date), 10)
)
```

## Optional: Save Predictions

```{r save, eval=FALSE}
out_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "models", "outputs")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(preds_df, file.path(out_dir, "rolling_predictions_logreg_v1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(metrics_df, file.path(out_dir, "rolling_metrics_logreg_v1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
